title: Rav Huna bar Luliani
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 36:8; Hyman suggests that perhaps the reading should be Rabbi Chiyya bar Luliani, as in Taanit 25a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text of Bereshit Rabbah 36:8 writes Rabbi Huna ben Luliani, whereas Hyman’s heading has Rav Huna bar Luliani. The William Davidson digital text of Taanit 25a names Rabbi Chiyya bar Luliani. The suggested identification remains Hyman’s tentative conjecture.

The actual Torat Emet Bereshit Rabbah 36:8 has Rabbi Huna ben Luliani, beside Hyman’s Rav Huna bar Luliani heading. Davidson Taanit 25a fully writes Rabbi Chiyya bar Lulyani. The full local title is supported; Hyman’s perhaps/should-read conjecture retains its force without identifying the two men. The existing note remains verbatim.
